checks: if [ -n "$BRINDLE_BASE_BRANCH" ] && git diff --quiet "$BRINDLE_BASE_BRANCH"...HEAD -- src tests scripts pyproject.toml uv.lock; then echo "no Python changes on this branch: skipped (runs in full on the session branch and in PR CI)"; else uv run pytest -q -n auto -m 'not serial'; fi

if [ -n "$BRINDLE_BASE_BRANCH" ] && git diff --quiet "$BRINDLE_BASE_BRANCH"...HEAD -- src tests scripts pyproject.toml uv.lock; then echo "no Python changes on this branch: skipped (runs in full on the session branch and in PR CI)"; else uv run pytest -q -m serial; fi

rules: Tests must earn their place (see .brindle/rules/learned.md): ask workers for the fewest tests that would fail without the change, and treat padded, duplicate or wording-only tests in a review as blockers.
